THE CHINA PRESS, SUNDAY, APRIL 18, 1937

Organ To
Fight Slave
Traffic Due

Child Welfare Ass'n
Sponsoring New
Organization

FOLLOW RULES OF
JAVA CONFERENCE

Jabin Hsu Announces
Plans For Health
Contest In May

An organization to co-ordinate
the battle against the traffic in
women and children will be started
soon in Shanghai, it was announced
yesterday by Mr. Jabin Hsu,
General Secretary of the National
Child Welfare Association, at a
meeting of the Executive Com-
mittee of the association.
Delegates from various local or-
ganizations interested in the pro-
blem will meet shortly to organize
such an organization.
The group will also attempt to
carry out the resolutions adopted
by the Conference for the Preven-
tion of Traffic in Women and
Children held recently in Java
under the sponsorship of the
League of Nations.
Mr. Hsu also announced plans
for a child health contest to be
held in May to arouse public
interest in the health of children
in Chapel.
The Chapel Child Welfare Clinic,
conducted by the association, will
be used as headquarters for the
contest.
Approximately 500 children, rang-
ing from the ages of 1. to 10, are
expected to participate in the
contest. The children will be given
preliminary physical examinations
from May 24 to 26. The final ex-
amination will be held on May 27.
Winners in the contest will be
awarded prizes contributed by
interested firms. The prizes will be
given on May 29 in the clinic.
Among the Executive Committee
members present at yesterday's
meeting at the Chinese Bankers'
Association were:
Dr. R. Y. Lo, Mrs. [□□□□]
[□□□], Mrs. W. S. [□□], [□□].
[□] [□□], Mr. Ling Kung-hou, Mr.
Andrew V. Wu, Mrs. Huang Mu-
feng, Mr. Huang Bai-Ming and Mr.
S. U. Sau.

《字林西报》，1937年4月18日，星期日

打击人口贩卖
机构即将成立

儿童福利协会
赞助新组织

遵循爪哇会议
规则

徐季彬宣布五月
举行健康比赛计划

全国儿童福利协会总干事徐季彬（Jabin Hsu）先生昨日在该协会执行委员会会议上宣布，上海不久将成立一个协调打击妇女和儿童贩卖活动的组织。
关心此问题的各地方组织的代表将于近期开会，组建该组织。
该团体还将试图执行最近由国际联盟赞助、在爪哇举行的防止贩卖妇女和儿童会议所通过的决议。
徐先生还宣布了一项将于五月举行的儿童健康比赛计划，以引起公众对闸北（Chapel，注：此处原文为Chapel，结合语境及后文Chapel Child Welfare Clinic，应指闸北或特定区域，但根据要求保留原文或按当时通译，此处“Chapel”极可能是“Chapei/闸北”的OCR误识或特定称呼，鉴于后文有明确Chapei用法，此处暂依原文音译或保留，但考虑到历史背景，Chapel Child Welfare Clinic通常对应闸北儿童福利诊所。根据要求“能确定的用当时通行的中文”，Chapei=闸北。此处原文为Chapel，若视为Chapei之误，则译为闸北。若视为独立地名则音译。鉴于上下文高度疑似OCR错误将Chapei误为Chapel，且后文提到Chapel Child Welfare Clinic，故译为闸北。）儿童健康的关注。
由该协会运营的闸北儿童福利诊所将作为比赛的总部。
预计约有500名年龄在1至10岁的儿童参加比赛。儿童将于5月24日至26日进行初步体检。决赛将于5月27日举行。
比赛的获胜者将获得由热心企业捐赠的奖品。奖品将于5月29日在诊所颁发。
出席昨日在中国银行家协会举行的会议的执行委员会委员包括：
罗如柏（R. Y. Lo）博士，[□□□□]夫人，[□□□]夫人，W. S. [□□]夫人，[□□]。[□] [□□]，凌公侯（Ling Kung-hou）先生，吴安德（Andrew V. Wu）先生，黄慕凤（Huang Mu-feng）夫人，黄百明（Huang Bai-Ming）先生以及S. U. Sau先生。

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, WEDNESDAY, MARCH 17, 1937

MEASURES AGAINST
WHITE SLAVERY
Mr. H. C. Chen Describes
League Conference

OVER 25,000 PROSTITUTES
IN CHINA

A suggestion was put forward by Mr. H. C. Chen, of the Educational Department, S.M.C., yesterday that an international anti-kidnapping society should be formed, for the purpose of ensuring the welfare, protection, and employment of needy women in Shanghai, and for providing special homes and relief for Russian women. Mr. Chen was addressing members of the British Universities and Schools Luncheon Club on the recent conference organized by the League of Nations to discuss measures for eradicating the white slave traffic menace.

Mr. Chen said that the civilization of a country could to a large extent be measured by the standard of the women it had produced. Slavery used to be very widely practised, and although now a fraction of what it used to be, it had been replaced by another evil traffic in women and children.

From 1924 to 1926, the League sent out a Commission of Enquiry into the traffic in women and children, following which a report on the situation was issued. In 1930, the League turned to the East. Another Commission of Enquiry was sent out, and spent 1½ years in the Orient. The report which was issued commenting on the white slave traffic stated that of the 17,000 women and girls who were registered as foreign prostitutes, only 174 were actually found to be occidentals. Practically the whole number of "foreigners" were found to be orientals. There was probably an equal number of unregistered prostitutes. In China, the report stated, there were 5,000 registered, and from 20,000 to 25,000 unregistered prostitutes. The white slave traffic in the East, therefore, was one of great importance.

Women Abducted

Nine nations were represented at the conference, and there were 30 official delegates from these nations, in addition to 80 representatives of government and voluntary organizations. There were, continued Mr. Chen, [illegible text block] in Shanghai every year, besides many cases of which no record was made. Women and girls were also abducted in other parts of China to be sold as prostitutes. The girls were sold to the Eastern provinces, where men far out-numbered women, and boys were sold to the Southern provinces, being sent into the country by overseas Chinese.

Mr. Chen mentioned six items on the agenda at the conference to show the kind of problems dealt with. Among the questions discussed was closer co-operation between Chinese police and the police of foreign concessions in coping with the white slave traffic, the protection of women and children migrating to Eastern countries, the possibility of abolishing licensed and [illegible] brothels in the Far East, [illegible] between the police [illegible] the appointment of women judges and [illegible] from [illegible] the protection of [illegible] in the East.

Among the resolutions passed were those for the establishment of a Bureau of Information with regard to the white slave traffic, and the appointment of a liaison officer in the Far East to co-ordinate the various efforts being taken to combat the traffic.

With regard to venereal disease, Mr. Chen pointed out that from 70 to 80 per cent. of the prostitutes in Shanghai were diseased among the high grade, and 80 per cent. among the low grade. Steps must be taken to abolish the disease by medical and social measures. Closer collaboration was required among the private organizations. Delegates to the conference had approached wealthy philanthropists who would be willing to contribute money for the upkeep of a competent person in the Far East to deal with the problem of Russian women living on this side of the world.

Mr. Singloh Hsu was in the chair, supported by Mr. W. S. King.

《华北每日新闻》，1937年3月17日，星期三

打击白奴贸易的措施
陈鹤琴先生描述国联会议

中国有两万五千多名妓女

工部局教育处陈鹤琴（H. C. Chen）先生昨日提出建议，应成立一个国际反绑架协会，旨在确保上海贫困妇女的福利、保护和就业，并为俄罗斯妇女提供专门的住所和救济。陈先生是在向英国大学和学校午餐俱乐部的成员发表讲话时提出这一建议的，他谈到了最近由国际联盟组织的讨论消除白奴贸易威胁措施的会议。

陈先生表示，一个国家的文明程度在很大程度上可以通过其女性的素质来衡量。奴隶制曾经非常普遍，虽然现在的规模仅为过去的一小部分，但它已被另一种邪恶的妇女和儿童贩卖活动所取代。

1924年至1926年，国际联盟派遣了一个调查团调查妇女和儿童贩卖情况，随后发布了一份关于该情况的报告。1930年，国际联盟将目光转向东方。另一个调查团被派出，并在东方度过了1年半的时间。发布的关于白奴贸易的报告指出，在注册为外籍妓女的17,000名妇女和女孩中，实际上只有174人是西方人。几乎所有的“外国人”都被发现是东方人。未注册的妓女数量可能与此相当。报告称，在中国，有5,000名注册妓女，以及20,000至25,000名未注册妓女。因此，东方的白奴贸易是一个极其重要的问题。

妇女被绑架

九个国家派代表出席了会议，除了来自这些国家的30名官方代表外，还有80名政府和志愿组织的代表。陈先生继续说道，上海每年都有[文字模糊不清]起绑架案，此外还有许多未记录的案件。中国其他地区的妇女和女孩也被绑架并被卖为妓女。女孩被卖到男性人数远多于女性的东部省份，男孩则被卖到南部省份，由海外华侨送入内地。

陈先生提到了会议议程上的六个项目，以说明所处理的问题类型。讨论的问题包括：中国警察与外国租界警察在应对白奴贸易方面更紧密的合作，保护移民到东方国家的妇女和儿童，在远东废除持牌和[文字模糊不清]妓院的可能性，警察之间的[文字模糊不清]合作，任命女性法官和[文字模糊不清]以保护[文字模糊不清]在东方的[文字模糊不清]。

通过的决议包括建立关于白奴贸易的情报局，并在远东任命一名联络官，以协调打击该贸易的各种努力。

关于性病，陈先生指出，上海高等级妓女中有70%至80%患有性病，低等级妓女中则有80%患病。必须采取医疗和社会措施来消除这种疾病。私人组织之间需要更紧密的合作。会议代表已接触富有的慈善家，他们愿意捐款资助一名胜任的人员在远东生活，以处理居住在世界这一侧的俄罗斯妇女问题。

徐新六（Singloh Hsu）先生担任主席，W. S. King先生在旁支持。

Prostitution Serious Menace
To Shanghai's Welfare

League Conference Delegate Lectures On Question
Before Luncheon Club; Advocates Interest In
Vital Social Problem Here Immediately

Mr. Singloh Hsu was in the chair, supported by Mr. W. S. King.

THE CHINA PRESS, MONDAY, MARCH 8, 1937

Map Anti-Slave Drive

Representative of nine Far Eastern countries gathered at Bandoeng, Java, last month to study measures for pushing the anti-slavery campaign in the various nations in the Orient. Among the Chinese delegates were Mr. H. C. Chen, Chinese Educational Officer of the S.M.C. and Miss Hilda Chen, Secretary of the Waichiaopu Shanghai Office, who are shown in the above picture with representatives of other

Delegates Back, Tell Of
Anti-White Slave Plans

League Of Nations Bureau Here To Be Sought
By Conference, Says Chen, Fresh From Java

Aiming to bring effective co-ordination in the campaign against the slave traffic in China, a League of Nations Bureau with permanent headquarters in Shanghai and Tientsin is likely to be established, Mr. H. C. Chen, Chinese delegate of the Far Eastern Anti-Slavery Conference at Bandoeng, Java, told pressmen yesterday upon his return here.

A recommendation asking the League to establish such a central anti-slavery office was adopted by the Bandoeng meeting, and Mr. Chen hopes that the Bureau will open for work here in the latter part of this year.

Returning with Mr. Chen yesterday were Mr. Hsiung Hsi-ling, noted philanthropist and one-time premier of the Peking Government; Mrs. Hsiung; and Miss Kwang Jui-wu, Superintendent of the Hsiang Shan (Peiping) Orphanage.

Mr. Chen, who is the Chinese educational officer of the Shanghai Municipal Council, represented the National Child Welfare Association, while Mr. Hsiung acted as the chief adviser of the Chinese delegation.

Co-ordinating Agency

The proposed League anti-slavery bureau will act as a co-ordinating agency in bringing about proper co-operation between Chinese and foreign Settlement and Concession authorities in their anti-slavery war.

Mr. Chen pointed out yesterday that in the League of Inquiry report it was revealed that in Shanghai there is no co-operation whatsoever among the Settlement, Concession and City Government authorities in the anti-slavery campaign.

Shanghai, he said, is considered in the Far East as the center of the slave traffic. The Anti-Kidnapping Society here was instrumental in discovering no less than 400 cases of children slave traffic during last year.

Another important measure adopted by the anti-slave meeting aimed to bring co-operation between the foreign shipping companies and the Chinese police authorities. The League of Nations Bureau, he said, will be asked to advise the Chinese Government as well as foreign governments on this particular project.

Want Foreign Co-operation

Mr. Chen explained yesterday that if the foreign shipping firms could be persuaded to co-operate actively in the anti-slave drive, the result would lead directly to an improvement of the present situation.

The City and the National Government, he said, would be asked by the League Bureau to write letters to the shipping companies asking for their much-needed co-operation.

The conference, Mr. Chen said, also recommended that the proposed League Bureau should receive regular reports from all participating countries regarding the traffic in women and children. At the same time, the central anti-slavery office will be made responsible for distributing and collecting vital information on the slave traffic.

In this way, he pointed out, the co-operation not only extends to the foreign and Chinese authorities inside of China, but also among the various nations in the Far East.

Apart from these measures, the Bandoeng meeting also recommended that the various national anti-slavery groups should embark on an educational and publicity campaign aimed at the abolition of licensed or tolerated houses of ill-fame.

Employ More Women

Another resolution of the meeting advocated that the participating nations should employ more women in anti-slavery work.

Regional conferences sponsored by the League and similar to the one held in 1935 in Hongkong should be called to discuss measures for pushing the anti-slavery drive, it was decided.

Regarding traffic in Russian women, the conference adopted a resolution for the creation of another League of Nations office to supervise the work.

Funds to support this special office, however, are to be raised by the League among various philanthropic organizations.

The Chinese delegation, composed of eight persons, played an active part, Mr. Chen said, in the conference. The delegation was headed by the Chinese Consul-General at Batavia.

（批：File 5/8 8/3）

《字林西报》，1937年3月8日，星期一

制定反奴隶制运动方案

上个月，九个远东国家的代表齐聚爪哇万隆，研究在东方各国推进反奴隶制运动的措施。中方代表包括工部局华务教育处处长陈鹤琴先生（Mr. H. C. Chen）和外交部上海办事处秘书陈海利女士（Miss Hilda Chen），上图所示即为她们与其他国家代表的合影。

代表归来，讲述反白人奴隶贸易计划

陈氏自爪哇归来称，会议将寻求在此设立国联办事处

刚从爪哇万隆远东反奴隶制会议归来的中方代表陈鹤琴先生昨日向记者表示，为了在中国境内的反奴隶贩运运动中实现有效的协调，可能会建立一个以国联为后盾、常设总部位于上海和天津的办事处。

万隆会议通过了一项建议，请求国联建立这样一个中央反奴隶制办公室，陈先生希望该办事处能在今年下半年在此开展工作。

昨日与陈先生一同回国的还有著名慈善家、前北京政府总理熊希龄先生，熊夫人，以及香山（北平）孤儿院院长关瑞梧女士。

身为上海公共租界工部局华务教育处长的陈先生，代表中国全国儿童福利协会出席会议，而熊先生则担任中国代表团的首席顾问。

协调机构

拟议中的国联反奴隶制办事处将作为一个协调机构，促使中外租界及公地当局在反奴隶制战争中开展适当合作。

陈先生昨日指出，国联调查团的报告揭示，在上海，租界、公地和中国市政府当局在反奴隶制运动中毫无合作可言。

他说，上海被视为远东奴隶贩运的中心。本地的反拐卖协会在去年发现了不少于400起儿童奴隶贩运案件。

反奴隶制会议采取的另一项重要措施，旨在促进外国航运公司与中国警察当局之间的合作。他说，将请国联办事处就这一特定项目向中国政府以及外国政府提供建议。

希望获得外国合作

陈先生昨日解释说，如果能说服外国航运公司在反奴隶制运动中积极合作，结果将直接改善目前的状况。

他说，国联办事处将要求市政府和国民政府致函各航运公司，请求它们提供急需的合作。

陈先生表示，会议还建议，拟议中的国联办事处应定期从所有参与国接收关于妇女和儿童贩运的报告。同时，中央反奴隶制办公室将负责分发和收集有关奴隶贩运的重要信息。

他指出，通过这种方式，合作不仅扩展到中国境内的中外当局，还扩展到远东各国之间。

除这些措施外，万隆会议还建议，各国反奴隶制团体应开展教育和宣传活动，旨在废除持牌或受容忍的妓院。

雇用更多女性

会议的另一项决议主张，参与国应在反奴隶制工作中雇用更多女性。

会议决定，应由国联赞助召开区域性会议，类似于1935年在香港举行的那次会议，以讨论推进反奴隶制运动的措施。

关于俄罗斯妇女贩运问题，会议通过了一项决议，决定另设一个国联办事处来监督相关工作。

然而，支持该特别办事处的资金将由国联向各慈善组织募集。

陈先生表示，由八人组成的中国代表团在会议上发挥了积极作用。代表团由驻巴达维亚中国总领事率领。

（批注：档案 5/8 8/3）

THE CHINA PRESS, FRIDAY, FEBRUARY 5, 1937

Concessions Hit For
Aiding Women Traffic

Allegations Of Chinese Envoy
Refuted By Jordon

BANDOENG, Java, Feb. 4.—
(Reuters).—A strong attack against
foreign concessions in China, with
an implication that they tended to
aid traffic in women, was made by
the Chinese delegate at today's ses-
sion of the League of Nations con-
ference on traffic in women and
children.
The Chinese delegate alleged
that foreign concessions did not
properly control the granting of
passports for women.
The allegation was denied by a
British delegate, Mr. A. B. Jordon,
representing the Straits Settle-
ments, who reviewed the measures
taken to prevent traffic in women
in the East.
He pointed out that China's cen-
tral office dealing with the matter
was only established in 1933.
The conference today also dis-
cussed the establishment of a Lea-
gue central office.
page_data.zh:
《字林西报》，1937年2月5日，星期五

谴责租界协助妇女贩运

乔丹驳斥中国使节指控

爪哇万隆，2月4日电——（路透社）。在今日举行的国联妇女和儿童贩运问题会议上，中国代表猛烈抨击了在华外国租界，暗示其倾向于协助妇女贩运。

中国代表指控外国租界未能适当管控妇女护照的签发。

代表海峡殖民地的英国代表A. B. 乔丹先生否认了这一指控，他回顾了为防止东方妇女贩运所采取的措施。

他指出，中国处理此事的中央机构直到1933年才成立。

今日会议还讨论了设立国联中央办事处的问题。

THE CHINA PRESS, THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 4, 1937 S. B. F D 7779

LEAGUE REPORT ON
WHITE SLAVERY
MEET PUBLISHED

GENEVA, Feb. 2—(Transocean
Kuomini).—M. Joseph Avenol, the
Secretary-General of the League
of Nations, today published the re-
port of the work of the East
Asiatic Central Committee which
is now meeting in Banteng, Java,
to plan a co-operative campaign
against white slavery.
The British Empire, the United
States, France, China, India, Japan,
the Netherlands, Portugal and Siam
are represented on the committee.
It is working on a basis established
by the League of Nations' commis-
sion which has investigated the
conditions in numerous harbor
cities of the Far East in 1930-31
and ascertained that white slave
trade is still carried on to a con-
siderable extent especially in the
coastal cities of India, China,
Japan and Manchuria.
Extreme satisfaction is ex-
pressed here over the fact that the
conference again is being held un-
der the auspices of the League of
Nations.

2/6

《字林西报》，1937年2月4日，星期四 S. B. F D 7779

国联发布白人奴隶制
会议报告

日内瓦，2月2日电——（跨洋通讯社 Kuomini）。国联秘书长约瑟夫·阿韦诺尔先生（M. Joseph Avenol）今日发布了东亚中央委员会的工作报告。该委员会目前正在爪哇万丹（Banteng）开会，策划一场反对白人奴隶制的合作运动。

大英帝国、美国、法国、中国、印度、日本、荷兰、葡萄牙和暹罗均在委员会中派有代表。

该委员会的工作基于国联委员会确立的基础，该委员会曾在1930-31年间调查了远东众多港口城市的情况，并查明白人奴隶贸易仍在很大程度上进行，特别是在印度、中国、日本和满洲的沿海城市。

此处对会议再次在国联主持下举行表示极为满意。

2/6
JBR

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, THURSDAY, JANUARY 7, 1937    18290

                                                                        7 . 2

ANTI-WHITE SLAVE
CONFERENCE

China's Former Premier to
Attend Meeting

The Chinese delegation to the Far
East Anti-White Slave Conference,
convened under the auspices of the
League of Nations, will leave Shang-
hai aboard the ss. Tjisaroea on
January 19 for Bandoeng, Java, to
attend the meeting which is to open
on February 2.
The delegation will include Mr.
Hsiung-Hsi-ling, former Premier of
China and now president of the
Swastika Society in China, Miss.
Kwang Jui-wu, superintendent of
the Hsiang Shan Orphanage of which
Mr. Hsiung is the director, and Mr.
Chen Keh-chin, a member of the
China National Child Welfare Asso-
ciation and director of the S.M.C.
Chinese Schools.
Mr. Farsan T. Sung, Chinese Con-
sul-General at Batavia, has also been
instructed to attend the meeting. The
League is calling the meeting to
discuss ways and means to suppress
the sale of women and children in
this part of the world and it is
stated that China, Japan, Siam,
France, Portugal, the Netherlands,
India and Great Britain will send
representatives to take part in the
deliberations. The United States
and the Philippines will send audi-
tors to sit in at the discussions.
According to the present agenda,
the delegates will seek to establish
closer co-operation between the
police authorities of each country in
an attempt to run down white slave
traffickers. The questions of im-
migration and protection of emigr-
ants, abolition of licensed houses of
prostitution and the White Russian
problem in the Far East will also
come up for discussion.
Mr. Hsiung, who will be accom-
panied by his wife, it is learned, will
make a tour of the South Seas fol-
lowing the closing of the conference
to investigate the child welfare work.
--Central News.

《字林西报》，1937年1月7日，星期四    18290

                                                                        7 . 2

反白人奴隶制
会议

中国前总理将出席会议

在国联主持下召开的远东反白人奴隶制会议的中国代表团，将于1月19日乘坐“芝萨鲁亚”号轮船（ss. Tjisaroea）离开上海前往爪哇万隆，参加定于2月2日开幕的会议。

代表团成员包括：中国前总理、现任中国红卍字会会长熊希龄先生；熊先生任董事长的香山孤儿院院长关瑞梧女士；以及中国全国儿童福利协会会员、工部局华童公学董事陈克进先生（Mr. Chen Keh-chin）。

驻巴达维亚中国总领事宋发祥先生（Mr. Farsan T. Sung）也已奉命出席会议。国联召开此次会议旨在讨论抑制本地区妇女和儿童买卖的方法和手段，据悉，中国、日本、暹罗、法国、葡萄牙、荷兰、印度和大不列颠将派遣代表参加审议。美国和菲律宾将派出旁听员列席讨论。

根据目前的议程，代表们将寻求加强各国警察当局之间的合作，以追捕白人奴隶贩子。移民及移民保护问题、废除持牌妓院问题以及远东的白俄问题也将列入讨论范围。

据悉，熊先生将由其夫人陪同，并在会议结束后巡游南洋，考察儿童福利工作。--中央通讯社。

THE CHINA PRESS, TUESDAY, OCTOBER 27, 1936

China To Join Confab
Against White Slavery
Nations To Discuss Preven-
tion Traffic In Women

GENEVA, Oct. 26.—(Havas).—
China today signified her willing-
ness to participate in a conference
of "central authorities of Far East-
ern States" to consider the preven-
tion of traffic in women and child-
ren in the Far East. The confer-
ence is being held at Bandoeng
Java, on February 2, 1937.
Of the various powers concerned
only the Soviet Union has refused
to send representatives.—France
India, Japan, the Netherlands, Por-
tugal, Siam and the United States
all agreeing to be present.
Measures will be considered aim-
ing at securing closer co-operation
of the police forces of the powers
interested to suppress the White
Slave traffic.
The conference will also examine
problems connected with immigra-
tion.

《字林西报》，1936年10月27日，星期二

中国将参加反白人奴隶制会议
各国将讨论预防妇女贩运

日内瓦，10月26日电——（哈瓦斯社）。中国今日表示愿意参加“远东各国中央当局”会议，以商讨预防远东地区妇女和儿童贩运事宜。该会议将于1937年2月2日在爪哇万隆举行。

在各相关强国中，只有苏联拒绝派遣代表。法国、印度、日本、荷兰、葡萄牙、暹罗和美国均同意出席。

会议将审议旨在加强有关强国警察部队合作以镇压白人奴隶贸易的措施。

会议还将审查与移民有关的问题。
